penguins \|\> filter(species == "Gentoo" \> 5000) \|\> count()

penguins \|\> mutate(flipper_to_mass_ratio = bill_len/bill_dep) \|\> arrange(desc(flipper_to_mass_ratio))

penguins \|\> mutate(flipper_to_mass_ratio = flipper_len/body_mass) \|\> arrange(desc(flipper_to_mass_ratio))

penguins \|\> mutate(heavy = body_mass \> 4500)

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
penguins |> relocate(body_mass) |> head()
penguins |> arrange(desc(flipper_len)) |> head()
penguins |> relocate(bill_dep, bill_len, flipper_len, body_mass, .after = species)

penguins |> filter(species == "Adelie") |> count()

penguins |> filter(species == "Gentoo" & body_mass > 5000) |> count()

penguins |> select(contains("bill"))

penguins |> filter(body_mass > 5000) |>
            distinct(species, island) |> count()

penguins |> mutate(body_mass_kg = body_mass/1000) 

penguins |> mutate(flipper_to_mass_ratio = flipper_len/body_mass) |> arrange(desc(flipper_to_mass_ratio))

penguins |> mutate(heavy = body_mass > 4500)

penguins |> 
   mutate(flipper_class = case_when(
          flipper_len > 190 & flipper_len < 200  ~ "big",
          flipper_len > 180 & flipper_len < 190  ~ "big",
          TRUE ~ "small"
          ))
```

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
penguins |> glimpse() |> count(island)
```
